The path is rollback-free with one plain recovery (the exclusions LiveAt names, no FI blanking) that keeps the rules or installs ruleset nextRules + 1, then lands the new generation's first block, from the checkpoint c to c+1. Normal-operation liveness, adversarial scheduling, DAO transaction refinement and production/launch refinements remain separate.
